svg.aria-label: ContacTeam — The sales desk built around your team
svg.title: ContacTeam — The sales desk built around your team

g.text: The sales desk built around your team
Instead of squeezing a team into an off-the-shelf CRM,
it is set up around how they sell. Every customer from
WhatsApp, Instagram, site chat and lead forms is tied
to a rep and comes back to the same person. Calls,
messages and outcomes sit on one screen.
